# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 40 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_040_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 40

**1** Jesus said: "A grapevine has been planted outside the Father; and since it has not taken root, it will be pulled up by its roots and will perish."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Outside the Father" — the spatial image; divine location = the source of growth
- "Has not taken root" — the weakness is a consequence of the wrong planting location
- "Pulled up by its roots" — total destruction; no remnant
- "Will perish" — the end is definitive
